messages.subject: ddply( .variables = .() ,...) fails
parts:
ddply( data.frame(a=1:3) , .() , identity )
=> Error in args[[i]] : attempt to select less than one element

Splitting on zero variables (i.e. processing the whole df as one) seems like a perfectly reasonable case.
